About the Author

Writing from the space between the everyday and the eternal.

A. Moore is the author of What If...? Food for Thought, a provocative political and speculative fiction novel exploring faith, justice, and the weight of the choices we make.

"Writing is more than a passion for me; it is a calling. My greatest joy comes from creating stories so vivid that readers feel as though they are living within the pages themselves. Through these five powerful stories, I pray that readers gain understanding, reflection, and inspiration from every chapter."
A. Moore
